scope.execution: static read-only review informed by existing Story 4.5 performance evidence; tests were not run

performance_metrics.avg_test_duration_estimate: Not inferred from source; existing query evidence records 60 samples totaling approximately 4.49 seconds

observations.assessment: The 50,000-row in-memory SQLite seed is required by Story 4.5 AC7, is inserted inside one transaction, and queries only bounded 30-item pages. It is therefore not treated as an unnecessary large-data performance violation.

The Playwright cases navigate once per independent journey; the single reload verifies URL-filter restoration and the source/feed round trip verifies navigation-context preservation, so neither is excessive navigation.

No direct Story 4.5 test uses a serial describe group. Playwright is configured fully parallel, while the Rust, Vitest, and E2E cases construct bounded per-test state and expose no performance-only reason to serialize them.
The direct tests contain no waits above two seconds, page.$$-style bulk queries, or unbounded polling; semantic locators and framework-native async waits dominate browser interaction.

recommendations: Retain the purpose-built 50,000-row AC7 gate and continue storing its raw samples and P95 evidence.
Track the complete performance-test wall time, including dataset seeding, so future regressions against the 1.5-minute test-quality target are visible.
Keep Story 4.5 browser journeys parallel and avoid introducing serial groups or hard waits.
summary: No performance violations were found across the 31 Story 4.5 tests; execution remains parallel-friendly and bounded, and the required 50,000-row query gate is comfortably below its 200 ms P95 threshold.
